scope: Road geometry and manual annotation protocol only; automatic membership remains pending validation.
rules: Inspect original full image, not masked/cropped ROI, so roofs and riders outside road polygon remain visible.
Decide target approach and physical road contact/base evidence, not bbox center, bbox overlap alone, shadow, or rider foot.

A visible contact point assists review but is not the sole membership rule; if vehicle spans a boundary, contact point conflicts with visible body/base, or important contact is hidden, use boundary_review or unknown.
A point within 3px at1280width (4.5px at1920) of any ROI boundary is flagged for review. This is a conservative annotation aid, not a calibrated physical error bound.
Do not invent a hidden wheel/contact point; do not turn unknown into outside/zero. Resolve with documented review before scoring; if unresolved mark frame/region incomplete and report scope.

Stop boundary follows visible paint upstream edge where available, with virtual extension over missing portions. Upstream virtual boundary fixes study extent and is not queue tail or calibrated road length.

The same final accepted four-class object list feeds count and coverage. Coverage is union of visible half-open bboxes intersected with full fixed road mask, divided by road mask area; overlaps counted once.
Mark moving/arriving context separately if known from curation; a static input cannot establish duration of stopping. No new vehicle annotation is made in this ROI step.
Future runtime membership rule must be implementable from single image detections and validated independently. Ground contact annotations are not available automatically at inference.
